title: Model, Not Mode: a pre-registered model x mode grid (harness and dataset)
description:
A pre-registered model x mode grid (LA-P4). Six LLM families are each run in a fast and a reasoning mode on one frozen, constrained systems-design prompt, five replicates per cell, 60 answers collected in each vendor's own web app. Answers are scored blind by three raters with a nine-dimension rubric, and the variance in each dimension is decomposed into model, mode, interaction and residual shares.

The release holds the modegrid harness (code, MIT), the configuration, the randomised manifest, all captures, the blinding rules, the rater sheets, the consensus scores and every analysis output (data, prompts and docs, CC-BY-4.0).
notes: Code is MIT (LICENSE). Data, prompts and documentation are CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). Captured model output stays attributable to the system that produced it.
